messages.author: a4e2cc09f1e031bc
messages.subject: Error in if (num_cores_to_use > num_cores_computer_has) { :    missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Hi all,

I am attempting to run a time-stratified analysis with different DEC models for each time period. I have been able to create the BioGeoBEARS_run_object and see that it has all of my parameters: 

BioGeoBEARS_run_object <- define_BioGeoBEARS_run()
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$trfn <- treefile
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$timesfn <- "timeperiods.txt"
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$geogfn <- geogfn
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$max_range_size <- max_range_size
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$min_branchlength <- 0.000001
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$include_null_range <- TRUE
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$areas_allowed_fn <- "geography.txt"

But when I go to do the runslow loop, I get the following error. 

Your computer has 16 cores
Error in if (num_cores_to_use > num_cores_computer_has) { :
    missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I have not been able to find anywhere in the run_object where I could place a TRUE/FALSE statement in running my analysis. 

Any and all help with this would be greatly appreciated!

Best,

Brenen

Hi -- try running

library(parallel)
library(snow)

...before you run the code.  Or, try one or the other of these.

Cheers!
Nick

messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error in if (num_cores_to_use > num_cores_computer_has) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Hi -- 

Type BioGeoBEARS_run_object$num_cores_to_use and see if it gives you a number.  The code is just running a true/false operation on 

num_cores_to_use > num_cores_computer_has

...if one of these is not a number, you would get that error message. It says you have 16 cores so probably it's num_cores_to_use.

Cheers,
Nick
